_about: The only file to edit when adding a collection. Each entry becomes a chip in the layer switcher and a card under the map. The number shown is always counted from data/<id>.json; the denominator is the world total, with its as-of date. Pin shape is set per shelf so color is never the only signal. Captions marked [COPY NEEDED] are placeholders for Nancy's words. Reconciled with the Claude Design file TLL Map Layers (7 October 2026): 36 lists in five shelves, caption bank with templated numbers, source badges.
